+"""Unit tests for risk.annualize (spine: daily values pass through)."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import dataclasses
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from typing import Any
+
+import pytest
+
+from risk.annualize import annualize
+from risk.types import Returns, VolSeries
+
+
+def vol_from_sample(data: dict[str, Any], *, annualized: bool) -> VolSeries:
+    r = data["returns"]
+    returns = Returns(
+        base_date=r["base_date"],
+        dates=tuple(r["dates"]),
+        tickers=tuple(r["tickers"]),
+        values={t: tuple(v) for t, v in r["values"].items()},
+    )
+    return VolSeries(
+        returns=returns,
+        window=data["window"],
+        annualized=annualized,
+        values={t: tuple(v) for t, v in data["values"].items()},
+    )
+
+
+def test_daily_sample_becomes_annualized_with_values_passed_through(
+    contract_sample: Callable[[str], dict[str, Any]],
+) -> None:
+    daily = vol_from_sample(contract_sample("risk.VolSeries"), annualized=False)
+
+    out = annualize(daily)
+
+    assert out.annualized is True
+    assert out.returns == daily.returns
+    assert out.window == 2
+    assert out.values["ACME"][:2] == (None, None)
+    assert out.values["ACME"][2] == pytest.approx(0.5573826203591309)
+    assert out.values["BOLT"][4] == pytest.approx(0.16124865888434922)
+    assert dataclasses.replace(out, annualized=False) == daily
+
+
+def test_already_annualized_raises(contract_sample: Callable[[str], dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
+    annual = vol_from_sample(contract_sample("risk.VolSeries"), annualized=True)
+
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="already annualized"):
+        annualize(annual)

+"""max_drawdown spine: depth of the deepest fall below the running peak."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from typing import Any
+
+import pytest
+
+from risk import Drawdown, Returns, max_drawdown
+
+DATES = ("2024-01-02", "2024-01-03", "2024-01-04", "2024-01-05")
+
+
+def make_returns(**simple: tuple[float, ...]) -> Returns:
+    """Returns whose log values are those of the given simple returns."""
+    return Returns(
+        base_date="2024-01-01",
+        dates=DATES[: len(next(iter(simple.values())))],
+        tickers=tuple(sorted(simple)),
+        values={t: tuple(math.log1p(r) for r in rs) for t, rs in simple.items()},
+    )
+
+
+def test_depth_is_fall_from_peak_to_trough() -> None:
+    # wealth 1.0, 1.25, 1.0, 0.75 -> peak 1.25, trough 0.75: 0.75 / 1.25 - 1 = -0.4
+    (drawdown,) = max_drawdown(make_returns(AAA=(0.25, -0.2, -0.25)))
+    assert drawdown.ticker == "AAA"
+    assert drawdown.depth == pytest.approx(-0.4)
+
+
+def test_deepest_of_two_falls_wins() -> None:
+    # wealth 1.0, 0.9, 1.8, 1.08: falls -0.1 and 1.08 / 1.8 - 1 = -0.4
+    (drawdown,) = max_drawdown(make_returns(AAA=(-0.1, 1.0, -0.4)))
+    assert drawdown.depth == pytest.approx(-0.4)
+
+
+def test_fall_below_starting_wealth_counts() -> None:
+    (drawdown,) = max_drawdown(make_returns(AAA=(-0.5,)))
+    assert drawdown.depth == pytest.approx(-0.5)
+
+
+def test_no_fall_is_zero_depth_at_base_date() -> None:
+    returns = make_returns(AAA=(0.01, 0.02, 0.0))
+    assert max_drawdown(returns) == (
+        Drawdown(ticker="AAA", depth=0.0, peak_date="2024-01-01", trough_date="2024-01-01"),
+    )
+
+
+def test_one_drawdown_per_ticker_in_ticker_order() -> None:
+    returns = make_returns(BBB=(0.1, -0.1), AAA=(-0.2, 0.0))
+    drawdowns = max_drawdown(returns)
+    assert [d.ticker for d in drawdowns] == ["AAA", "BBB"]
+    assert drawdowns[0].depth == pytest.approx(-0.2)
+    assert drawdowns[1].depth == pytest.approx(-0.1)
+
+
+def test_returns_sample_gives_valid_drawdowns(
+    contract_sample: Callable[[str], dict[str, Any]],
+    contract_fake: Callable[[str], Any],
+) -> None:
+    returns = contract_fake("risk.vol_series").returns_from_json(contract_sample("risk.Returns"))
+    drawdowns = max_drawdown(returns)
+    assert tuple(d.ticker for d in drawdowns) == returns.tickers
+    by_ticker = {d.ticker: d for d in drawdowns}
+    # ACME wealth peaks at exp(r0) and bottoms at exp(r0 + r1 + r2)
+    acme = returns.values["ACME"]
+    assert by_ticker["ACME"].depth == pytest.approx(math.exp(acme[1] + acme[2]) - 1)
+    # BOLT only rises
+    assert by_ticker["BOLT"].depth == 0.0
+    for drawdown in drawdowns:
+        assert drawdown.depth <= 0
+        assert drawdown.peak_date <= drawdown.trough_date

+"""rolling_vol spine: expanding sample stdev of the returns before each date."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from typing import Any
+
+import pytest
+
+from risk import Returns, rolling_vol
+
+DATES = ("2024-01-02", "2024-01-03", "2024-01-04", "2024-01-05", "2024-01-08")
+
+
+def make_returns(**series: tuple[float, ...]) -> Returns:
+    return Returns(
+        base_date="2024-01-01",
+        dates=DATES[: len(next(iter(series.values())))],
+        tickers=tuple(sorted(series)),
+        values=series,
+    )
+
+
+def test_none_until_window_earlier_returns_then_expanding_stdev() -> None:
+    returns = make_returns(AAA=(0.01, 0.03, -0.01, 0.05, 0.0))
+    vol = rolling_vol(returns, 2)
+    values = vol.values["AAA"]
+    assert values[:2] == (None, None)
+    # stdev(0.01, 0.03) = 0.02 / sqrt(2)
+    assert values[2] == pytest.approx(0.02 / math.sqrt(2))
+    # stdev(0.01, 0.03, -0.01): mean 0.01, squared deviations sum 0.0008, / 2 -> 0.0004
+    assert values[3] == pytest.approx(0.02)
+    # stdev(0.01, 0.03, -0.01, 0.05): mean 0.02, squared deviations sum 0.002, / 3
+    assert values[4] == pytest.approx(math.sqrt(0.002 / 3))
+
+
+def test_larger_window_delays_the_first_value() -> None:
+    returns = make_returns(AAA=(0.01, 0.03, -0.01, 0.05, 0.0))
+    values = rolling_vol(returns, 3).values["AAA"]
+    assert values[:3] == (None, None, None)
+    assert values[3] == pytest.approx(0.02)
+
+
+def test_keeps_returns_window_and_is_not_annualized() -> None:
+    returns = make_returns(AAA=(0.01, 0.02, 0.03), BBB=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0))
+    vol = rolling_vol(returns, 2)
+    assert vol.returns is returns
+    assert vol.window == 2
+    assert vol.annualized is False
+    assert vol.values["BBB"] == (None, None, 0.0)
+
+
+def test_window_below_two_is_rejected() -> None:
+    returns = make_returns(AAA=(0.01, 0.02, 0.03))
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="window"):
+        rolling_vol(returns, 1)
+
+
+def test_returns_sample_gives_a_valid_vol_series(
+    contract_sample: Callable[[str], dict[str, Any]],
+    contract_fake: Callable[[str], Any],
+) -> None:
+    returns = contract_fake("risk.vol_series").returns_from_json(contract_sample("risk.Returns"))
+    vol = rolling_vol(returns, 2)
+    assert set(vol.values) == set(returns.tickers)
+    for ticker, values in vol.values.items():
+        series = returns.values[ticker]
+        assert len(values) == len(returns.dates)
+        assert values[:2] == (None, None)
+        assert values[2] == pytest.approx(abs(series[0] - series[1]) / math.sqrt(2))
+        assert all(isinstance(v, float) and v >= 0 for v in values[2:])
